title: CONOR SHANAHAN IS THE 2026 FD CHAMPION
caption:
One judges' call away from the title. Conor Shanahan beats Jhonnattan Castro in Top 32 and is the 2026 Formula DRIFT champion. 🇮🇪🏆

🎥 Footage: FD LONG BEACH FINALE
